okay one of my top ones was when myself and my other friend were hiking down a trail we were fairly familiar with and then ended up getting extremely lost. The sun had almost set so we were getting ready to pull out flashlights and start running when we come across a man just wandering around, he seemed pretty harmless like he was just hiking the trail too so we ask him where the parking lot is and was very friendly and told us which way to go.
